title: The Case for the American Manufacturing Asset Class | Andreessen Horowitz
gist: a16z's Connor Love and Collen Larson argue that venture-funded defense tech has outrun a fragmented, small-firm US supplier base, and that Tier 2/3 manufacturers are an underpriced investment whitespace. Unlocking it requires Pentagon anchor demand, supplier co-engineering instead of build-to-print, technology-driven modernization (e.g., Hadrian, Amca), and a capital stack handing off from venture to PE and credit, creating a new American manufacturing asset class.
